en: Vintage postcard with three colorized photographic panels showing the same older man in different poses in an outdoor colonial-era town setting. The man wears a long patterned wrap skirt and a jacket; in the left image he carries a pole on his shoulder, in the middle he walks in front of a house and wooden fence while other people look on from a doorway, and in the right image he appears to dance or move energetically, with another man and a donkey in the background. The caption at the bottom right reads "S. Thomé." and another caption along the bottom center identifies him as a servant of the firm Salvador Levy & Co.
